propositions: The auto-lander loop service must be containerized and deployed as a single-instance service via docker-compose on the Gerrit box with autoheal sidecar and flock guard for crash-safe restart.
The service must log exclusively to its own service logs, never to session_log, with loud error metrics and stuck-state alarms for visibility of hangs, errors, and wedge conditions.
A heartbeat mechanism writing a state-volume timestamp file every 15 seconds (freshness ≤ 15 s, lander_down trigger at > 90 s age) must enable liveness detection and crash-safe recovery.
The bot must report per-change outcomes back to Gerrit via comments and Autosubmit label state, with a read-only HTTP status endpoint exposing heartbeat_age_s for land command consumption.
A stuck-state alarm must fire when any wipChain phase persists in non-idle state for > 45 minutes, published as autolander_time_in_phase_seconds CloudWatch metric.

Credentials (SSM token AUTOLANDER_GERRIT_TOKEN) and Gerrit Rebase access right on rebar project refs/heads/* must be provisioned; drain-on-SIGTERM with recovery record and idempotency testing must complete deployment validation.
